summary: Completed comprehensive testing of The Tamale Man restaurant website focusing on logo support, notifications, file uploads, menu add-ons, and Stripe checkout integration. Most features working correctly with minor backend schema issues identified.

critical_bugs.issue: Missing notification_emails, header_logo, footer_logo, and favicon fields in database settings
critical_bugs.impact: Admin cannot configure logos or notification emails through UI

critical_bugs.issue: Toppings format mismatch - expects strings but receives objects with name/price
critical_bugs.impact: Orders with add-ons fail validation (422 error)

passed_tests: Landing page displays with header showing site name (ready for logo when uploaded)
Footer shows proper 3-column layout with brand section (1/3 width)
Navigation elements all present and functional
Menu add-ons are selectable with visual feedback (red styling when selected)
Add-ons price calculation works correctly (base price + toppings = item total)
Order checkout form has all required fields (name, email, phone, date, time, comments)
Order form validation and date/time selection working
Admin login page properly protects admin routes with Google authentication
File upload endpoint (/api/upload) accepts images and returns proper URLs
Admin Settings has 'Logos' tab with ImageUploader components for header/footer logos
Admin Settings has 'Notifications' tab for managing multiple notification emails
Image dimension guides present (200x60px header, 250x150px footer)
All basic API endpoints (health, menu, testimonials, FAQ, contact) working
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix backend settings schema: 1) Update database settings to include notification_emails, header_logo, footer_logo, favicon fields from SiteSettings model. 2) Fix order toppings format - backend expects List[str] but frontend sends List[Dict] with name/price. Consider updating OrderItem model to accept toppings as objects or modify frontend to send strings.
